module_summary: Majority-vote glitch filter: shifts d_i into a WindowLen history register, popcounts it via a child, and outputs 1 when the count meets the threshold.

anchors.name: history_q
anchors.why: Shift register of the last WindowLen samples, fed to the popcount child.

anchors.name: popcount_o
anchors.why: Number of ones in the history window, compared against Threshold.

anchors.name: q_o
anchors.why: Filtered output: popcount at or above the majority threshold.

anchors.name: d_i
anchors.why: Raw input bit shifted into the history window.

anchors.name: en_i
anchors.why: Sample enable gating the history shift register update.

groups.name: History window
groups.description: Enable-gated shift register holding recent input samples.

groups.name: Majority decision
groups.description: Popcount child and threshold compare producing the filtered output.
